svg.title: What I'd do with a long instructions file
svg.desc: The file is long and the replies are fine: Leave it alone. On Sonnet and Opus every rule that applied was followed at 800 rules, so trimming buys you a smaller bill and an easier file to read, not better replies. You're adding a rule: Say when it applies, in words the task will contain. Every rule in my list did that, and I can't separate that from the result. A rule has changed: Delete the old one anyway. Claude used the update in all 288 replies, but the next person editing the file won't work that out. A rule has to show up in every reply: Keep that group short and check it on Haiku. Given ten of them, it named only one or two in 6 of 18 replies. A rule can never be broken: Check the reply with a script before it goes out. Haiku still wrote a banned word in up to 1 reply in 12, and the wrong desk twice. Something got missed and you reach for IMPORTANT: Look for the reason first. I couldn't measure any benefit from it, though Sonnet and Opus left no room to improve. Written for one-turn replies from rules I could check by code. Long conversations and rules that take judgement are untested.
svg.text: What I'd do with a long instructions file
For replies written from a list of rules on Claude, as of November 2026.

replies are fine

smaller bill and an easier file to read, not better
replies.

Every rule in my list did that, and I can't separate that
from the result.

Delete the old one anyway. Claude used the update in all
288 replies, but the next person editing the file won't
work that out.
A rule has to show up in
every reply
Keep that group short and check it on Haiku. Given ten of
them, it named only one or two in 6 of 18 replies.
A rule can never be
broken
Check the reply with a script before it goes out. Haiku
still wrote a banned word in up to 1 reply in 12, and the
wrong desk twice.
Something got missed and
you reach for IMPORTANT
Look for the reason first. I couldn't measure any benefit
from it, though Sonnet and Opus left no room to improve.
Written for one-turn replies from rules I could check by code. Long conversations and
rules that take judgement are untested.
